## Build with an agent

Give your coding agent the Akropolys integration skill.

npx skills add https://akropolys.cloud --skill akropolys-integration

## How to connect your data

Akropolys connects to your data in two ways: send a batch of records together, or send one record at a time. Both build the same search index.
